videos.desc: A couple hikes through a narrow slot canyon with wavy orange rock walls; they run their hands over the smooth stone and look up at the thin strip of sky, cupping their mouths to shout and hear the echo.

By a wood stove in a snowy cottage a man picks shiny black lumps of coal from a metal bucket, showing the black dust on his hands to a laughing woman. He loads the coal into the stove with tongs and the fire flares up bright orange.

A drone glides low down a deep forested gorge, following a foaming grey river between bare layered rock walls with dense green slopes rising on both sides; there is no road, no building and no person anywhere in the shot.

A young couple wanders through a mountain field full of wild poppies, daisies and cornflowers, brushing their hands over the blooms. They watch a bee land in a red poppy, tuck a daisy behind his ear, and finally flop down laughing in the tall grass.

In a hand-painted anime scene, a man tips a rusty barrel of brown sludge off his truck into a clean river between rice terraces; the muck spreads across the water while fish scatter and a chimney smokes in the hills. A girl in a yellow raincoat wading with a bucket finds the water fouled, covers her nose and says "Oh no!" sadly.

Bare feet walk along a bleached log lying just under the surface of a glass-clear alpine lake. The water is so transparent that the stones and sunken branches on the bottom stay sharp. The camera lifts to a snow-capped mountain mirrored in the still surface, then drops under the water, where a small orange frog swims towards the lens above the sunken log.

A first-person view from a yellow kayak racing down a narrow jungle river, the paddler's blue sleeve and black paddle swinging in and out of shot. White water rushes past the nose of the boat between mossy rock walls and dense green foliage, with a rainbow hanging in the mist ahead. The kayak is carried straight over the lip of a waterfall and drops into the spray, the screen filling with white water; it comes out below in the mist and carries on downstream, where another paddler in a red kayak is running the same rapid ahead.

A green parrot stands on bare red earth while a hand lowers a tiny motocross helmet onto its head. The parrot hops onto a miniature dirt bike and rides off down a track of deep red-brown dirt that runs through open eucalyptus woodland. A low close-up shows the rear tyre spinning on the loose dirt as the bike speeds along, then the camera looks up from ground level as the parrot launches the bike off a mound of red dirt and lands, riding away over the ridge.

A wide shot of a lake at dusk under a clear blue and yellow sky. The water is completely flat and mirrors the dark line of fir trees on the far shore and the pale glow of the sky, so the treeline appears twice, once above the waterline and once below it. On the right a large rock juts out over the water and a person crouches in silhouette on its edge. They spring off, hit the water, and the smooth mirrored surface breaks into wide rings that travel outward. The swimmer's head appears in the middle of the rings and moves slowly across the lake as the water settles again.

A drone shot that starts close on three women in bright swimsuits standing together on a small strip of white sand, then climbs and pulls back. As it rises, two enormous grey limestone walls come into the frame on the left and right, rising sheer out of the sea and closing in on the little beach so that it sits at the bottom of a narrow slot. Palms and thick green jungle spill over the top of the beach behind them. In front, a shallow turquoise lagoon with dark patches of reef stretches out between the two rock walls towards the open sea.

A chest-mounted point-of-view shot from a skydiver sitting in the open door of a helicopter over the Alps. His own legs in a white padded suit and tan boots hang out over a wall of high mountains whose ridges and summits are thickly covered in white snow, with a bare green valley running between them and the sun blazing overhead. He drops away, and the helicopter tips over above him and shrinks into the deep blue sky as the snow-covered peaks and glaciers slide past below. Under canopy he comes down towards a bright green alpine meadow with a large orange landing cross laid out on the grass, his boots pointing at it.

A point-of-view ride on a chestnut horse in an orange bridle along a wet black-sand beach under a grey sky. The horse walks straight towards a black cliff and into the mouth of a sea cave, and the frame goes almost completely black except for the outline of the horse's ears. A bright doorway of daylight appears ahead, and horse and rider come out again onto the open black beach with a green headland beyond.

A single skier is a tiny dark figure high on a huge, smooth, untouched snow face under a deep blue sky. He skis down the long incline, throwing up a bright plume of powder snow behind him. The camera pulls back and the whole snow face is revealed dropping away at a steep angle from the ridge at the top all the way down towards the water, with snowy mountain peaks and a fjord catching the low orange sun on the far side.

A young man with curly hair and a light blue and white striped scarf walks along a colourful street, then sits at a shaded outdoor table drinking from a mate gourd through a metal straw. The clip then cuts to him standing alone at a viewing railing in front of an enormous wall of blue glacier ice that fills the whole frame behind him and stretches out of shot on both sides. He is tiny against it, and he throws both arms out wide.

A woman in a khaki field vest stands at the edge of a bright turquoise mountain lake and holds black binoculars to her eyes, scanning the far shore and the pine slopes behind it. She lowers them, reacts, and lifts them again. The scene cuts to a canyon overlook at dusk, where she steps up to a coin-operated tower viewer on a post, grips the handles and presses her face to the eyepiece to look at the rock formations miles away across the canyon.

On a beach at dusk a young woman in a denim jacket crouches over a fire. The fire is ringed by a circle of big pale blocks of rough natural stone, laid one against the next on the sand to make a low wall around the flames, and their grainy, pitted surfaces are lit up orange by the fire inside. She leans over the stones and feeds thin sticks into the middle, the flames climb up between them, and she sits back on her heels with the stone ring glowing in front of her while the sea and two figures show dark behind.

A man in an orange puffer jacket and a fur trapper hat rides a small red cable car up a mountain, grinning at the camera as snow-laden conifers slide past the window below. He steps out at the station and boards a larger white gondola, then rides on over a ski slope, with rows of snow-covered pines lining the valley and jagged white peaks ahead.

On a sunny beach a shirtless boy in yellow swim shorts digs into the sand with a metal spade while a light brown dog scrapes at the sand beside him. He throws shovelful after shovelful onto the mounds around him and the hole grows steadily deeper and wider. At the end he and the dog are both sitting down inside the finished hole, with only their heads and shoulders showing above the sand, the sea behind them.

A man in a bright yellow raincoat and waterproof trousers stands in an open front doorway wearing tall green rubber boots caked in mud. He stamps his feet hard on the coir doormat on the step; a close shot shows the boots plastered in wet brown mud and clumps of it falling off onto the mat, which is left dotted with dark lumps. He then walks in through the doorway along a clean wooden hallway floor and stops, standing on the polished boards in his boots.

A boy in a green t-shirt crouches on a bank of round pebbles beside a clear turquoise mountain river and sets a small white paper boat down on the water. The current takes it at once: the boat is carried out from the shallow pebbly edge into the deeper green water and moves steadily away downstream, turning slowly as the surface ripples past it. The camera follows it as it travels the length of the reach and passes under the arch of an old stone bridge, with white rapids visible upstream beyond the bridge, until the boy is left standing on the grassy bank watching it go.

A dark tropical beach at night. A woman in a white shirt stands at the water's edge where the breaking waves shine bright blue, and bends down towards them. She crouches and drags her fingers through the wet sand, and hundreds of tiny points of blue light flash on around her hand. She draws a curling spiral in the sand that glows blue and slowly fades. In the last shot she stands back as a wide sheet of water rushes in, the whole shoreline flashing with blue points of light under a full moon and palm trees.

A helmet-camera view straight down at a climber's red suit and boots as he stands on a knife-thin snow ridge. The ridge runs away from him in a long narrow crest of trodden snow that rises to a summit point, with a solid white sea of cloud far below on both sides and the curved horizon and deep blue sky beyond.
videos.said: I walk right along the top of the world.

videos.desc: A young man with a large backpack and trekking poles pushes his way up a steep grassy mountain path; the camera follows him from behind and then from the front while the slope falls away below him to a wide alpine valley and rows of distant peaks.

Two walkers with big backpacks and trekking poles climb a rust-coloured pine forest path, sunlight coming through the trunks behind them. The trees thin out and they pick their way up a bare grey rock slope with a wall of snow-covered peaks opening up across the valley behind them. They pull themselves up the last stones onto a narrow rocky crest under a deep blue sky, and stand at the top looking out over a huge white mountain range, raising their poles above their heads.

A young woman with pink hair in a yellow raincoat cycles along an Amsterdam canal, laughing, with narrow gabled houses and moored boats behind her. She then walks away from the camera through a tulip field with her arms spread wide, a big windmill turning directly in front of her as the shot pushes in on the red and yellow rows. Finally she stands at a market stall holding a fresh stroopwafel, pulling it apart and biting into it while the waffle irons steam behind her.

A woman in navy overalls and work gloves stands knee-deep in a brown river whose surface is covered with floating plastic bottles, plastic cups, plastic bags and white foam; a factory with a smoking chimney and pipes stands on the bank behind her. She bends down, pulls a plastic bottle out of the water, grimaces at it, and straightens up holding it while more rubbish drifts past along the shore.

Close up on black gloved hands gripping a white rope on a flagpole, a red flag bunched at the top of the frame; behind, a flat field of snow runs out to a straight line where the white ground meets the blue sky. Three people in orange polar suits pull the rope together and the red flag climbs the pole. In the wide shots the empty snow plain stretches to that same distant line in every direction, with one small dark hut on it. The four of them finish standing at the foot of the pole, looking up at the flag.

A selfie-style travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and checked headscarf holds the camera at arm's length on a red dune with the sun setting behind him, laughing and turning. He then stands at a sandstone cliff and runs his hand over huge human figures carved out of the rock, tilting his head back to see the top of them. At night he sits by a campfire under a starry sky while tea is poured into his cup, and he holds the cup up smiling.

A young man in a red beanie and a checked shirt sits on a park bench and squashes a piece of rubbish into a ball in his hands, then drops it into a round steel park bin beside the bench. He walks on past a big green metal dumpster on a city pavement, looking back at the camera. In a wide open square he throws a piece of rubbish in a high arc towards a long row of colour-coded bins, each marked with a recycling symbol, and watches it fly in.

The dark ash slope of a volcano at sunset. A huge column of grey smoke and ash billows up from the crater into a pink sky and keeps growing. In the foreground a young woman with curly hair tied back, sunglasses, a beige and dark brown jacket and jeans looks through a measuring instrument on a tall tripod pointed at the eruption, then straightens up, shields her eyes with one hand to watch the cloud, and bends to the instrument again. Another person works further away and wind blows dust over the ground.
